meta.title: AI chat applies a custom prompt to the Vendor Assessments section

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create flow required for a Technical Stage.
Provide the mandatory event title before configuring the technical stage.
Create an event containing only the Technical Stage.
Move to the Technical Stage before configuring its questionnaire.
Apply a technical-stage template so questionnaire content can be configured.
Populate the technical-stage questionnaire, establishing Vendor Assessments content for the AI prompt test.
Complete the required evaluator setup for the Technical Stage.

args.goal: On the Technical Stage with AI-generated questions, click the Green AI icon to open the AI chat side panel, choose Vendor Assessments as the section, enter the test instruction in the chat textbox, click Send, and verify that the Vendor Assessments questions change while the Line Items content remains unchanged.

steps.note: Perform and observe the AI chat flow and its two required outcomes, which no dedicated catalog step exposes.
Confirm the AI update flow completed without an application error.
